sources.label: Korean translation patches for VocaColle, built for Morphe.
sources.author: ilikeadofai
patch_list: Optionally changes the launcher name and icon while preserving the original Japanese branding by default.
Adds complete English static, hardcoded, and server-provided UI localization.
Adds complete Korean static, hardcoded, and server-provided UI localization.
Adds opt-in controls for VocaColle advertising surfaces.
Verifies that VocaColle 7.40.0 can be decoded, rebuilt, and signed without changing app behavior.
Adds display-language, cache, diagnostic, and patch-version controls to native Morphe settings.
Adds opt-in exact VocaDB title metadata to the full player.
